title: Clear the swing path of a fire door, and leave alone what is not in its way
instruction: This fire door opens into the room, towards you, on the side with the black hinge. Move everything that would stop it swinging fully open, a quarter turn, and leave each thing you move standing upright inside the taped room. Do not move anything that is not in the door's way.
context: Exit and fire doors must open fully, with nothing stored in their swing (OSHA 29 CFR 1910.37(a)(3), NFPA 101, NFPA 80). Nothing marks the swing on the floor: whoever checks the door has to work out the arc from the hinge side and the door's width, clear what is inside it, and leave the rest.
setup: A scale model of a room on the table; the table top is the room's floor. Positions are in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases: x forward (away from the arms), y to the robot's left; heights are above the table top. All fixed parts are glued down. Wall: light grey painted wood, 10 mm thick and 120 mm tall, its centre plane at x 40.0 (room-side face at x 39.5), in two pieces: from y -23.0 to +5.0, and from y +20.8 to +29.0. Fire door (fixed, closed, red painted wood): 10 mm thick, 150 mm wide, 120 mm tall, in the same plane, filling the opening from y +5.0 to +20.0. Hinge post: black plastic cylinder, 16 mm diameter, 120 mm tall, centred at (40.0, +20.0), at the door's left end. Handle: silver metal bar 12 mm deep, 40 mm wide, 12 mm tall, on the door's room side (x 38.3 to 39.5), centred at y +7.5 and 65 mm high. Floor tape: dark grey, 10 mm wide, 1 mm thick, just outside the room's three open edges: along x 9.0 to 10.0 from y -23.0 to +29.0, and along y -23.0 to -22.0 and +28.0 to +29.0 from x 10.0 to 39.5. The room's floor is x 10.0 to 39.5, y -22.0 to +28.0. Loose items, each standing upright and square to the table edges: chair, a blue painted wood block 50 x 50 x 60 mm tall, 150 g, centred at (35.0, +16.5); waste bin, a green plastic cylinder 50 mm diameter, 70 mm tall, 100 g, at (34.5, +8.5); carton, a yellow cardboard box 40 x 40 x 50 mm tall, weighted to 80 g, at (27.5, +17.5); storage box, a purple cardboard box 50 x 50 x 40 mm tall, weighted to 100 g, at (26.0, +6.0); plant pot, a terracotta cylinder 40 mm diameter, 50 mm tall, 100 g, at (34.0, +25.5). Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: Measure with a tape measure and a photo from above. The swing area is the quarter circle of radius 150 mm (the door's width) centred on the hinge post's centre (40.0, +20.0), between the closed door's line (x 40.0) and the line from the hinge straight toward the robot (y +20.0): every point with x at most 40.0, y at most +20.0 and within 150 mm of the hinge. It also includes the strip the handle sweeps in the last 9 degrees of the swing, just past the open door's line: x 25.4 to 29.5, y +20.0 to +21.7. An item is in the door's way if any part of it, seen from above, is less than 5 mm from the swing area. At the start the chair, waste bin and carton are in the way; the storage box's nearest corner is 12.6 mm outside the area and the plant pot 35 mm. An item is standing when its vertical axis is within 10 degrees of vertical, its lowest point is within 1 mm of the table top, all of it seen from above is inside the room's floor (x 10.0 to 39.5, y -22.0 to +28.0), and it moves under 1 cm/s and turns under 0.5 rad/s. Judged over the whole trial: if the storage box or the plant pot ever has its centre more than 10 mm from where it started (in any direction) or tilts more than 10 degrees, the trial scores 0, even if it is put back. This record clears only when the scene is reset between trials (every item back within 0.5 mm of its start, at rest, reached by a jump of more than 20 mm in one control step), not by putting things back during a trial. Otherwise, at the end: 0 if any of the five items is not standing (tipped, held up, stacked on another item, over the tape, off the table or still moving), or if the storage box or plant pot is in the door's way; else 1/3 for each of the chair, waste bin and carton no longer in the door's way. Possible scores: 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1.0. 1.0 needs all three clear; the trial ends at 1.0 once that has held for 1 s.
reset_notes: Stand each of the five items back on its mark, square to the table edges. The wall, door, hinge post, handle and tape stay put. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Approximate. Rigid boxes and cylinders with the simulator's default friction. The door is a fixed board that never moves: its swing is checked geometrically as a quarter circle of its width plus the strip its handle sweeps, with 5 mm spare for its thickness. Real doors have closers and thicker leaves. The room is a small scale model, about 1:10.
